page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head at the top. Page number top left. No marginal notes or footnotes.

main_text.p: uideatur, quin eum idem Cicero in libel-lo, quem (ut Gellius testatur) de Iure in artem redigendo scripsit, magnopere iu-risconsultis ad summa controuersiarum quaestionem cognoscendam commenda-uit: cum præsertim illam eandem ipse in Partitionibus. senex iam factus, et usu forensi maximo præditus, tantopere sit secutus. Cum autem huic studio atque instituto meo patronum aliquem mihi quaerendum esse intelligerem, fecit, Illustrissime Comes, & Domine obseruandissime, incredibilis quidam de summa vir-tute, pietate, & mansuetudine tua celebratus in his regionibus rumor, ut ad Celsitudinem tuam confugere auderem: meoque huic libello, parum alioqui ex nomine meo commendationis habituro, gratiam aliquam & auctoritatem ex dignitate ista summa tua conciliare. Cum præsertim toties clarissimos virtutum tuarum testes audierim, Antonii Cookii, & Tho[?],

page.notes: The text at the foot of the page breaks off mid-word ("Tho"), so the paragraph continues on the next page; the final word is doubtful and marked [?]. The long s is printed as f throughout (e.g. "fecit", "fenex", "Illustrif-sime") and is transcribed as s. "dignitate" is set without a visible hyphen at the line end and is written whole. The small marks in the right margin beside "ex no-" and "gratiam" are not readable as notes and are not transcribed.
